svg.text: MAPLE HOLLOW · FULL MAP DRAFT V3 (TO SCALE)
1 px here = 10 px in the game. Whole map 8,384 x 8,448 px, about 6.5 x 10.5 laptop screens. Big orange numbers = the age an area opens.
Your block (teal outline, bottom right) is already built. Everything else is a plan. Nov 12, 2026 (v3b).
The V8 chases you around the loop (60)
PORCH = END AT 65 · WHITE DOT = START
ROAD OUT OF TOWN (closed; opens in Full Life)
Roads; the orange ring is the loop
Every area has its boss arena and at least two entrances off the roads (96 px gaps, 224 px main routes).
Run rhythm: an area opens about a year before its boss, you explore, the swarm builds, boss, chest, calm.
Town Square sits in the middle, inside the loop, and opens at 53: you circle it for years, then the center of town opens up.
The Woods and the road out of town are for Full Life, which will connect to the office and later the hospital.
